reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text: Ever since I bought it, the Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence has been a total must-have in my bag and daily routine. It hydrates deeply and instantly repairs lips without being sticky at all. It's truly the best lip treatment I've ever used and an absolute best buy—I'll definitely be repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 自從買咗 Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence，佢已經成為我袋入面同日常護理入面必備嘅嘢。深層保濕，即時修護唇部，完全唔黏。真係係我用過最好嘅唇部護理，絕對係最抵買嘅！我一定會再買！

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text: This is great for overnight use! I put this on before bed and I woke up to soft and nourished lips. I definitely recommend this, especially during dryer weather. This will come in handy once winter starts drying my skin. There is no scent, and it feels nice on the lips without feeling greasy. Good product overall.
reviews.zh: 晚上用嚟好好！我瞓前塗咗，醒嚟嘅時候唇部軟滑、有營養。我絕對推薦，特別係天氣較乾燥嘅時候。冬天開始令我皮膚乾燥嘅時候，呢款就會好有用。冇味道，塗喺唇上感覺好舒服，唔會覺得油膩。整體嚟講係好產品。

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text: Love! So moisturizing with zero stickiness. I apply a light layer before bed on days when I know I didn’t drink enough water, and it helps so much - I no longer wake up with chapped lips. It’s a bit greasy and watery to layer with lip products for me so if I’d forgotten to apply it the night before and I have to go out, I like using it as a 10 min mask then wiping it off before makeup for a quick hydration fix. I always keep a backup in stock 💖
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！非常保濕，完全唔黏。我知道自己當日飲水唔夠嘅時候，會喺瞓前塗薄薄一層，效果好大，我唔會再醒嚟唇部乾裂。我覺得同其他唇部產品疊用有少少油同水，所以如果我前晚忘咗塗，而且當日要出門，我就會將佢當成 10 分鐘嘅面膜，之後化妝前抹走，即時補水。我成日都留一支後備 💖

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text:
One of the BEST purchases I’ve ever made. 
I have always had dry lips no matter how much water I drink and how much lipbalm I put in. With this product my lips magically become hydratedand soft since the first day I used it. I don’t know how or why but this product was a change gamer for me. 
Also, it’s important to say it does not have flavour nor scent. So for me that’s great because it’s not confortable when lipbalms have strong odors or leave a chemistal taste in your mouth. 
Overall I LOVED THIS PRODUCT, and will buy again once I finish the 4 I bought.
reviews.zh:
係我買過最好嘅產品之一。
不論我飲幾多水、塗幾多潤唇膏，我嘅唇一直都好乾。用咗呢款產品之後，由第一日開始，我嘅唇就神奇咁變得水潤同軟滑。我唔知點解，但係呢款產品係一件改變遊戲規則嘅產品。
另外，要講嘅係佢冇味道，亦冇香味。咁對我嚟講就好好，因為潤唇膏有強烈氣味，或者喺口入面留低化學味道，都會令人唔舒服。
整體嚟講，我非常愛呢款產品，等我用晒買咗嘅 4 支之後，一定會再買！

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text: My personal experience with this product wasn't good because when I applied it the next day I got cold sores all around my lips
reviews.zh: 我用呢款產品嘅個人體驗唔好，因為我第二日塗咗之後，唇四周都長咗唇皰疹。

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text:
Best lip care I have ever used !
With previous lip balms, I used to have to use them morning and night and they would still struggle to get my lips back on track.
I tried this one as soon as I received it, and just after one use I could see such a difference !
After two uses, my lips are completely back on track and healthy looking
Absolutely recommend !!
reviews.zh:
係我用過最好嘅唇部護理！
之前用潤唇膏，我要早晚都用，但係嘴唇都好難回復正常。
我一收到貨就試用，只係用咗一次，已經見到好大分別！
用咗兩次之後，我嘅嘴唇已經完全回復正常，睇落好健康。
絕對推薦！！

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text:
I got these because;
1. I cant live without lip balm
2. I love ceramide in products
3. They got a high rank so it made me curious
All in all, i like this lip balm - it’s hydrating and has no scent. I use it both AM and PM. It’s doesnt feel as heavy as a lip mask, but keeps my dry lips still moisturised :)
reviews.zh:
我買呢款係因為：
1. 冇咗潤唇膏唔得
2. 我好鍾意產品入面嘅神經醯胺
3. 佢哋排名好高，令我好好奇
總括嚟講，我鍾意呢款潤唇膏，佢保濕、冇味道。我早晚都用。佢唔似唇部面膜咁厚身，但係乾燥嘅嘴唇都可以保持滋潤 :)

reviews.shade: Torriden Solid In Ceramide Lip Essence 11mL 1+1
reviews.text:
It’s a very hydrating lip essence. I am really enjoying it and because I get very dehydrated lips.
 This lip essence from Torriden really soothes my lips and makes them look super juicy and full. I love the little packaging it’s super cute! The little quote is cute: we will be the stars for your voyage so poetic and lovely! I hope to try more from this brand soon!
reviews.zh:
係一款好保濕嘅唇部精華。我好享受用佢，因為我嘅嘴唇好容易脫水。
呢款 Torriden 唇部精華真係令我嘅嘴唇舒緩，睇落超級飽滿、水嫩。我好鍾意包裝，超級可愛！包裝上嘅小語錄都好可愛：「we will be the stars for your voyage」，好有詩意、好靚！我希望好快可以試吓呢個品牌嘅其他產品！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
